# Ultimate Motion Design

> Claude Code plugin (`umd`) to make and audit high-end motion design: promo, presentation, explainer and social videos, logo animations, animated films, animated web pages and 3D. Deterministic HTML-to-video rendering, 58 quality checks scored out of 10 with evidence, licence guard, token report. One command: `/umd:go`. MIT, no telemetry, French and English.

Install in Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add 1AngelMicka/ultimate-motion-design` then `/plugin install umd@ultimate-motion-design`, restart, then `/umd:doctor`. Agents installing it for a user should read AGENTS.md first.

## For agents

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/1AngelMicka/ultimate-motion-design/blob/main/AGENTS.md): how to install, check and guide a user, and how to use the CLI without Claude Code
- [llms-full.txt](https://1angelmicka.github.io/ultimate-motion-design/llms-full.txt): the whole documentation in one file

## Docs

- [Install](https://1angelmicka.github.io/ultimate-motion-design/en/installation.html): requirements, team install, update, uninstall
- [First project](https://1angelmicka.github.io/ultimate-motion-design/en/premier-projet.html): from `/umd:go` to a delivered video
- [Tips and prompts](https://1angelmicka.github.io/ultimate-motion-design/en/astuces.html): brief recipe, ready-to-copy prompts per kind of piece, styles by mood, what to say during production, a 20-minute real test
- [Style library](https://1angelmicka.github.io/ultimate-motion-design/en/bibliotheque.html): 784 styles and prompts with a preview of the result (still or video) and the prompt; each entry has a link `bibliotheque.html#<id>`
- [Commands](https://1angelmicka.github.io/ultimate-motion-design/en/commandes.html): every command, its arguments, the `umd` CLI and the files it creates
- [Routes and tech](https://1angelmicka.github.io/ultimate-motion-design/en/routes.html): routes, recipes, engines and every guide
- [Quality checks](https://1angelmicka.github.io/ultimate-motion-design/en/qualite.html): the 12 domains, 60 checks, profiles, thresholds and scoring
- [Licences](https://1angelmicka.github.io/ultimate-motion-design/en/licences.html): policy, install guard, known traps
- [Token economy](https://1angelmicka.github.io/ultimate-motion-design/en/tokens.html): what is loaded, what is measured in code, `/umd:tokens`
- [Troubleshooting](https://1angelmicka.github.io/ultimate-motion-design/en/depannage.html)
